name: hud_ui_mgr_static_init_and_register_at_exit
description: HudUiMgr::StaticInitAndRegisterAtExit constructs the global HUD manager and registers its atexit destructor callback.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. The retail body is compiler-generated static-initialization glue and should be byte-checked with the HUD manager static lifecycle cluster.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40d400 calls 0x40d410 HudUiMgr::StaticInit and tail-jumps to 0x40d420 HudUiMgr::RegisterAtExit.
0x40d410 HudUiMgr::StaticInit is functionally equivalent under target hud_ui_mgr_static_init.
0x40d420 HudUiMgr::RegisterAtExit is functionally equivalent under target hud_ui_mgr_register_at_exit.

The native static-init/register smoke invokes HudUiMgr::StaticInitAndRegisterAtExit directly, verifies the constructed HUD manager lifecycle state, then tears down and clears the native harness object so the registered callback can run at process exit without double-destroying the C++ global wrapper.
